page.notes: Printed "(36)" at head, shown as "(3 6)" in slanted type. The small asterisk after "mere." and the dash under "pradictam" are printer's marks, not text. Hebrew words are read with doubt, especially the Hebrew after "seu urbem" and the two after "parte" and "appositâ"; the word after "parte" is unreadable. The Hebrew in the second paragraph appears to be קדשׁ followed by ירושלם. Long s was read as s throughout. The text ends mid-word at "inter-", which is the catchword.
